title: HIV: Z21, B20 or R75
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's HIV status (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for HIV status.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y/o female presenting for routine follow-up. Pt reports feeling well today. She denies any acute symptoms, fevers, or weight loss. She remains on current antiretroviral regimen with good adherence. Pt states she has no HIV-related illness to date.

Medication List
- Tenofovir / Emtricitabine / Dolutegravir (daily)
- Multivitamin (daily)

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 122/78, HR 72, Temp 98.6F, RR 16, SpO2 98% on RA.
HEENT: Normocephalic, no scleral icterus, no pharyngeal erythema.
CV: RRR, no murmurs.
Lungs: CTAB.
Skin: No rashes or lesions noted.
Neuro: NAD.

Assessment
1. HIV positive. Pt is currently asymptomatic. CD4 count and viral load remain stable.

Plan
1. Continue current ART regimen.
2. Lab work ordered for routine monitoring of viral load and CD4 count.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, MD, 10/14/2026
explanations: HIV positive with no symptoms and no HIV-related illness ever: Z21 (HCC 1).

distractors.why: B20 is for AIDS or any HIV-related illness, current or past.
